ap_queue_rule: ap_queue: deficit_against_declared_floors -- at every slot k the class taken is the one with the largest deficit floor_c x (total + k) + waterfall_c(k) - (recorded_c + emitted_c) over the recorded at-bat stream (dispatch registry for the build classes, advisor recordOutcome rows for maintain, health unmeasured and placed at par); ties in class order initiative_build > build > maintain > health > inbox. SHORTFALL (proportional_to_remaining_floors, declared by the policy): a class whose rows run out at slot j releases its floor for every later slot to the classes still holding rows, split in proportion to their floors, accumulated as waterfall_c(k) on the deficit; the recorded stream keeps the declared floors. Inside initiative_build: initiative sequence rank first (rule 4 kept inside the class); inside both build classes: a lug whose up edge (lugEdges.js derived_from / dependency) is not done ranks below it, dependency-free siblings carry parallel_wave n, then priority, then estimate ascending; maintain keeps the allocation's order; health keeps signal order. Build rows stay unpriced.
